about: The fields of the continent-v2 server rows that are not coordinates, keyed by the scene marker record_id (the marker gives the position and the tile, through _continent_v2/frames.py). publish_server.py joins the two; a marker of kind npc_marker or interactive without an entry here is refused. No field may hold '|', '#' or a line break: the server's npcs.txt and interactives.txt loaders split on the pipe and do not strip inline comments.

npc-bettany-orl.name: Bettany Orl
npc-bettany-orl.greeting: Bread, broth, and whatever the last boat was willing to say out loud. The broth is better.
npc-bettany-orl.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback
npc-bettany-orl.servedFrom: M3 home_npcs.txt; said only after the flip (home_map = sw_isle, eloria/home.py reword_greetings). Before it, the isle copy landing_install_isle_cast stands from M2 says the Four Gates line, and so does the rollback

npc-ferryman-caldus.name: Ferryman Caldus
npc-ferryman-caldus.greeting: I keep the ferry under the green light. My lantern marks the channel when the mist closes in.
npc-ferryman-caldus.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback

npc-gate-warden-ilyon.name: Gate Warden Ilyon
npc-gate-warden-ilyon.greeting: Every people keeps a post on this isle. Keep your weapons low and your purpose clear, and we will get on.
npc-gate-warden-ilyon.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback

npc-grove-keeper-ammet-sorrel.name: Grove-Keeper Ammet Sorrel
npc-grove-keeper-ammet-sorrel.greeting: Pick from the low branches. The high ones belong to the palace, and the palace has not looked up in two hundred years.

npc-light-keeper-marta-quell.name: Light-Keeper Marta Quell
npc-light-keeper-marta-quell.greeting: The red light is the oldest on the isle and the cheapest to insure. Mind the dog; he is the expensive part.

npc-register-clerk-hemmen.name: Register Clerk Hemmen
npc-register-clerk-hemmen.greeting: The Landing Register is the only document all eight peoples ever agreed to sign. Mind how you write in it.
npc-register-clerk-hemmen.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback

npc-sluice-keeper-odo-fenn.name: Sluice-Keeper Odo Fenn
npc-sluice-keeper-odo-fenn.greeting: This brook feeds the castle, the grove and the lake, in that order. The beavers would like to change the order.

npc-tavi-unhar.name: Tavi Unhar
npc-tavi-unhar.greeting: Forty-one hulls since dawn. I am not hiding. I am counting.

npc-temple-warden-ostrid-hollin.name: Temple Warden Ostrid Hollin
npc-temple-warden-ostrid-hollin.greeting: Whoever falls on this isle wakes by the beacon, a stone's throw from my door. I count them in. I have not yet had to count anyone out.

npc-wayfinder-nesh.name: Wayfinder Nesh
npc-wayfinder-nesh.greeting: New ashore? Then start where everyone does, and I will not have to fish you out of the lake.
npc-wayfinder-nesh.greetingSource: the owner's pick, 2026-10-04 (continent-v2/review/isle_greetings_and_names.md section 2, the recommended line); the Four Gates line stays in the server's npcs.txt and npc_dialogue.txt for the rollback

obj-landing-register-desk.text: The Landing Register lies open on its desk: name, road, date, and four empty lines for the countersigns.

obj-ferry-n10.text: The Landfall ferry rides at the green light's quay, bound for Crownwater. Ferryman Caldus keeps the gangplank.

portal.landing: derived by publish_server.py: the server's eloria/continent_geography.py MAPS[destination].arrival, cross-checked against the server manifest's maps[] entry and continentGeography region and the client's legacy publication, refused unless it and its eight neighbours are walkable and steppable on the destination's vendored grid; never typed here
